aim_summary.goal: Reduce the overall height of the Nozzle Volcano part by 1 mm, confined to its threaded area.
preserve_targets: geometry of the Nozzle Volcano part outside the threaded area
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The long nozzle fitting is shortened by exactly 1 mm at the terminal end of its threaded area while all non-threaded geometry remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Trim 1 mm from the top terminal end of the threaded region of the long nozzle fitting.

steps.description: Split SOLID 8 at a plane 1 mm below its topmost extent and retain the lower portion.

expected_result.geometry: F009 and SOLID 8 have an overall height exactly 1 mm less than their original height, with material removed only from the top terminal portion of the threaded area.

validation_criteria.description: The final overall height of SOLID 8 is exactly 1 mm less than its original overall height.
The removed volume lies only within the terminal threaded area of F009.
All geometry of F009 below the trim plane and all other sections, features, and solids remain unchanged.
